rep.partial_message: Pull the handle to your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades.

checks.label: Body swinging
checks.message: Don't rock back and forth. Keep your torso tall and still.

checks.label: Neck or back rounding
checks.message: Sit tall with your chest up and your neck in line with your spine.

camera.title: Film from the side
steps: Prop your phone or laptop 2.5 to 3 m away, at about hip height, so the camera sees you side-on (90 degrees).
Keep your whole body in frame, from your head to your feet, and leave some space above and below.
Light the room from the front or above. A bright window behind you makes the camera lose your outline.
Wear fitted clothing so your joints are visible. Keep the weights or machine from covering the side facing the camera.
camera.note: Camera side-on at hip height, with the cable between you and the machine kept clear of your arm.

guidance.accuracy: Machines and cables hide parts of your body and move the load on a fixed path, so this rule tracks only the main joint angles and whether your torso stays still. Expect fewer and simpler cues than on free-weight lifts, and some missed reps if the machine covers your arms or legs.
